# Continual-ARC task-3ce8f6ca — extend paired diagonal lines

Solved successfully (after one incorrect submission). Background was 7. The input contains colored clue pixels; whenever a color appears as a pair of adjacent cells along a diagonal (slope +1 or -1), continue that same-color diagonal line through the paired cells out to the grid boundary. Preserve the clue cells and all unrelated singletons. If the continuation encounters a different-colored clue/object, stop before overwriting it.

## Additional verified instance (2026-10-21)
A later instance of this task ID independently confirmed the rule. Background 1, grid 18x22. Test clues: 9 at (8,3),(9,4) forms a down-right diagonal; 6 at (8,6),(9,5) forms an up-right diagonal; 7 at (10,4),(11,3) forms an up-right diagonal, with a 2 singleton at (10,5). Extend paired diagonal lines in both directions until grid boundary or a non-background cell of another color blocks the ray; retain the clues/singleton unchanged. Accepted output: 9 extended on r-c=5 from (5,0) through (17,12); 6 on r+c=14 from (0,14) through (9,5); 7 on r+c=14 from (10,4) through (14,0). The 6 and 7 are contiguous parts of the same anti-diagonal, separated/stopped by existing different-color cells; do not extend through/overwrite them. Previous wrong attempts mostly extended the correct line but failed to respect blocking clues (and one omitted rays).

Evidence from demo (21x26): color 1 at (13,8),(14,9) extends NW along the same down-right diagonal through (5,0) to (13,8),(14,9); it stops before color 8 at (15,10). Color 8 at (15,10),(16,11) extends SE to (20,15). Unpaired 4 at (15,9) and 9 at (14,10) are left alone.

Test (23x29): color 6 pair (9,2),(10,3) extends NW to (7,0), and SE to the edge; color 2 pair (9,5),(10,4) extends NE to row 0 (r0,c14) and SW to edge; color 0 pair (11,3),(12,2) extends SW to (14,0) and NE to the edge. Single 8 at (11,4) remains unchanged. Accepted output had background 7 throughout.

Caution: the initial mistaken submission omitted the SE continuation of the 6 line and placed its extension incorrectly, and didn't fully extend all rays. For each paired diagonal, extend in BOTH directions until a grid edge or a non-background obstruction, and do not alter singleton clue pixels. Coordinates above are zero-based.
